dedupe_keys.name: dataset 10 aerpaw helikite spectrum measurements at packapalooza festival in august 2023

description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. The August 2023 Packapalooza experiment records approximately 90 minutes of spectrum measurements around noon. The helikite remains near 5 metres for about 45 minutes and then reaches approximately 140 metres. Frequency sweeps extend to 6 GHz, take roughly 15 seconds each, and yield 364 sweeps. GPS and spectrum metadata support assessment of altitude-dependent occupancy and urban wireless spectrum management. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Urban wireless spectrum planning. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
